welcome_desc: Focus Guard needs a browser extension to track and block entertainment websites while you are in focus mode.
one_time_note: You only need to install it once. It takes about 1 minute.
open_folder_desc: Click the button below to open the extension folder. You will need this folder in the next step.
folder_opened_hint: Folder opened in File Explorer. Keep that window open.
dev_mode_hint: - the switch in the top-right corner
choose_extension_folder: Select the folder opened in Step 1:
extension_auto_connect: Done! The extension will connect to the app automatically.
waiting_connection: Waiting for the extension to connect...
connected_desc: Focus Guard is ready to protect you from entertainment sites.
